paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Israel suante kiangah gen inla, akiang uah, pasal hiam, numei hiamin leng banghiam thuchiam tuam, TOUPA dinga kipiakna Nazirit thuchiam achiam laiin uain leh ju a ngawl ding ahi;
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to Yahweh,

paite: Uain thuk leng, ju thuk leng a dawn ding ahi kei, grep tui leng dawnin grep mindup hiam, minvuai leng a nek ding ahi samkei hi.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

paite: A kihihtuam sungteng grep guia a laia a tang leng, a hawng leng a nek ding ahi kei.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

paite: Kihihtuamna thu achiam sungteng a lu leng met louh hial ding ahi: TOUPA adia a kihihtuam sung ni a kim mateng hihtuam ahi dinga, a sam a hawi ding ahi.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled, in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

paite: TOUPA adia a kihihtuam sungteng misi luang a naih ding ahi kei.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.

paite: A pa te, nu te, a unaupa te, a sanggamnu te hiam sih thu ah leng a kihihnin ding ahi kei, Pathian adia a kihihtuamnain a gak jiakin.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation to God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” is on his head.

paite: A kihihtuam sungteng TOUPA tuam ahi.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.

paite: A kiangah mi hongsi guihin, a kihihtuamna lutang honhihninta bang hileh, a kisiansak ni, a ni sagih niin a lu a met ding ahi.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

paite: Huan, ni giatniin kihoupihna puanin kongkhak a siampu kiangah vakhu kop khat hiam, vapal nou kop khat hiam hontawi ding ahi:
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huan, siampuin khat khelh thoihna dingin a lan dia, khat halmang thillat dingin, misi jiaka a hihkhelhna ah kilemna a bawlsak ding; huan, huai ni mah in a lu a hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

paite: Huan, moh thoihna dingin belamnou apa kum khata upa hontawiin a kihihtuam nite TOUPA kiangah a hih hoih nawn ding: a kihihtuamna hihnit a hihtak jiakin a maa pen lah bangmahlou ahita ngala.
english: He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

paite: Huan, hiaia Naziritmi, a kihihtuamna ni bi uh a kim hun chia hih dan dinga hi: kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah pi ding ahi ding:
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Huan, TOUPA dia thillat dingin belampa kum khata upa gensiatbei halmang thillat dingin khat, khelh thoihna dingin belamnou a nu kum khata upa gensiatbei khat, lemna thillat dingin belempa gensiatbei khat,
english: and he shall offer his offering to Yahweh, one male lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

paite: Silngou sohlouh tanghou leh tangbuang nel mahmah thaua mek tanghou leh tangbuang nel mahmah thaua mek tanghou beu leh thaua jut tanghoupek pa bawm khat, a tangbuang thillat ding uleh dawn ding thillat dingte toh a lat ding uh ahi.
english: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal offering, and their drink offerings.

paite: Huan, siampuiin huaite TOUPA maah a lan dinga, a khelh kithoihna leh a halmang thillat a lan ding:
english: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering.

paite: Huan, belampa pen bawma tanghou silngou sohlouhte toh lemna kithoih thillat adingte TOUPA kiangah a lan ding: siampuin tangbuang thillat leh dawnding thillat mahleng a lan tel ding hi.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: Naziritmiin kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah a kihihtuamna lu a met dinga, kihihtuamna sam a la dinga, lemna kithoihna thillat nuaia mei ah a khul tum ding hi.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

paite: Huan, siampuin belampa liang huanmin leh bawma silngou sohlouh tanghou khat leh silngou sohlouh tanghou pek pa khat a la dinga, Naziritmiin a kihihtuamna lua a met khitin a tawisak ding:
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite, after he has shaved the head of his separation;

paite: Huan, siampuin vei thillat dingin TOUPA maah a vei ding ahi; hiai siampu tuam ahi ding, awm vei leh liang vei toh: huai khit chiangin Nazaritmiin uain a dawn theita ding hi.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. This is holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

paite: Hiai ahi, Naziritmiin thuchiam dan leh TOUPA maa a thillat dan uh, amah utthua lat simlouhin: a kihihtuamna thuchiam dingjui jelin a hih ding ahi, chiin, chiin.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows, and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, besides that which he is able to get. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Aron leh a tapate kiangah, hichibangin Israel suante na vualjawl ding ahi; a kiang uah,
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

paite: TOUPAN nou honvualjawlin honveng jel hen:
english: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

paite: TOUPAN a mel na tunguah vaksak henla, hohhehpih jel hen:
english: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

paite: TOUPAN nou lam hongnga henla, lungmuanna nou honpia hen, chiin gen un, chiin genin.Huchibanga hihin Israel suante ka min tuansak ahi dinga, huan, ken ka vualjawl ding, chiin.
english: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

paite: Huchibanga hihin Israel suante ka min tuansak ahi dinga, huan, ken ka vualjawl ding, chiin.
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”
